summary.text: Bill Owen is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 131 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A business executive with a banking background, he chairs the Financial Institutions Committee.

paragraphs.text: Owen was born and lives in Springfield, Missouri.
He earned an undergraduate degree from Drury University and a graduate degree from the University of Wisconsin at Madison Graduate School of Banking.
His career experience includes working as a senior vice president of the Bank of Bolivar.
For the 2025-2026 session, he chaired the Financial Institutions Committee and was also assigned to the Budget Committee and the Pensions Committee.
